data.heading: Invertebrates
data.text: Scientists have divided animals into two broad groups, vertebrates and invertebrates.
Animals that don't have a backbone or spinal column are called invertebrates.
Invertebrate animals either have a hard exterior shell covering or no hard covering or skeleton at all.
